title: Code Snippet Manager
description: Build a code snippet manager that stores, tags, and searches code snippets by tag and language.

steps.title: Define the snippet data structure
steps.description: Create a `snippets` array with objects containing `id`, `title`, `code`, `language`, and `tags` (array). Add 3 sample snippets and log them.
hints: Snippet: { id: 1, title: 'Hello World', code: 'console.log("hello")', language: 'javascript', tags: ['beginner', 'basics'] }
Use a variety of languages and tags

codeTemplate.python:
import json

snippets = [
  {"id": 1, "title": "Hello World", "code": "print('hello')", "language": "python", "tags": ["beginner", "basics"]},
  {"id": 2, "title": "Fibonacci", "code": "def fib(n):\n    return n if n <= 1 else fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)", "language": "python", "tags": ["recursion", "math"]},
  {"id": 3, "title": "HTTP Server", "code": "from http.server import HTTPServer\nserver = HTTPServer...", "language": "python", "tags": ["web", "server"]}
]

print("Snippets:", len(snippets))
print(json.dumps(snippets[0]))

verification.successMessage: Snippet data structure is set up with code, language, and tags!
verification.failureMessage: Create a snippets array with at least 3 snippets, each having id, title, code, language, and tags.

steps.title: Implement addSnippet function
steps.description: Write an `addSnippet` function that takes `title`, `code`, `language`, and `tags`, creates a snippet object with a unique id, and appends it to the snippets array. Log the new snippet.
hints: Generate id: Math.max(...snippets.map(s => s.id), 0) + 1 or snippets.length + 1
Create snippet object with all fields plus id

verification.successMessage: New snippets can be added to the collection!
verification.failureMessage: addSnippet should create a new snippet with a unique id and the provided fields, then append it.

steps.title: Search snippets by tag
steps.description: Write a `searchByTag` function that takes a `tag` string and returns snippets containing that tag. Log the matching snippet titles.
hints: Log the count and titles of matching snippets

verification.successMessage: Snippets can be found by tag!
verification.failureMessage: searchByTag('beginner') should return 2 snippets: 'Hello World' and 'Array Map'.

steps.title: Search snippets by language
steps.description: Write a `searchByLanguage` function that takes a `language` string and returns snippets written in that language. Log the matching snippet titles.
hints: Log each snippet's title and code length

verification.test: output.includes('JS snippets: 2') && output.includes('Console Log') && output.includes('Arrow Function')
verification.successMessage: Snippets can be found by programming language!
verification.failureMessage: searchByLanguage('javascript') should return 'Console Log' and 'Arrow Function'.

steps.title: Render the snippet list
steps.description: Write a `renderSnippetList` function that takes a tag filter and returns a formatted string with snippet titles and their languages: `"1. Hello World [javascript]\n2. Fibonacci [python]"`. Log the result.
hints: If tag is provided, filter by it first
Join with newlines for the final string

verification.test: output.includes('1. Hello World [javascript]') && output.includes('2. Data Class [python]') && output.includes('3. Type Guard [typescript]')
verification.successMessage: Snippet list renders with numbering and language tags!
verification.failureMessage: renderSnippetList should format as '1. Hello World [javascript]\n2. Data Class [python]\n3. Type Guard [typescript]'.
